jobs.title: Robotics Systems Engineer II, Tech Deployment
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Amazon's Robotics (AR) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy industrial robotics and automation technologies across North America's fulfillment network. In AR TD, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in A develop.
  

  

As a Systems Engineer in AR TD, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro\-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross\-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology \& Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third\-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on\-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon\-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go\-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel\-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.
  

  

\*\*Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi\-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high\-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi\-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end\-to\-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer.
  

You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.
  

  

* You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go\-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.
* You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)
* You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization
* You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade\-offs between time, quality, and resources
* You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.
* You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.
* You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains
* You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment
* You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results

  

A day in the life  

In this role you will be focused on execution of end\-to\-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day\-to\-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.
  

  

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full\-time employees include:

3\. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  

4\. 401(k) Plan

**About Fluidstack**
====================


We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built \- but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.  

  



We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them \- with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization\-scale infrastructure for AI.

  

  

**We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!**


**How We Operate**
==================


* **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.
* **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
* **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
* **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
* **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

**The Capacity Delivery Team**
------------------------------


**Examples of key problems the team is working on**


* **Engineer gigawatts from drawing to energized, in months not years.** Capacity Delivery owns technical execution across every build: the drawings, the field questions, and the engineering calls that keep multiple concurrent gigawatt sites moving.
* **Engineer data centers that go up in months, not years.** At that pace rework is not an option: problems get caught on paper or they cost a data hall.
* **Design it once, build it a hundred times.** Every site's lessons roll into the reference design on the way to 10s to 100s of GWs, so each build starts ahead of the last.

**Role Scope**
--------------


* Own controls engineering for assigned sites: BMS and EPMS design review, integration oversight, and commissioning support.
* Review controls submittals against the standard: architecture, points, sequences, graphics.
* Oversee integrator programming quality before it reaches the field.
* Support Level 3 through 5 commissioning with engineering answers in hours.

--------------------------

* You've engineered building or industrial controls on mission critical projects.
* You read and write sequences of operations.
* You've reviewed integrator work and sent it back with specifics.
* You debug controls issues from the points list up.
* Bonus: Niagara or Ignition. EPMS platforms. Networking for controls. Commissioning experience.

The Director of Systems Engineering, Integration \& Test (SEIT) is a senior technical and

* Serve as the authority for engineering processes, systems engineering plans, integration plans, test approaches, and verification/validation frameworks.
* Ensure alignment and seamless coordination between product IPTs, Test IPT, Chief Engineers (CE), and Program Management as required.

Starlink is the world's largest satellite constellation with over 9,500 in\-orbit and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. * Experience with one or more of the following electrical test equipment: oscilloscopes, digital multimeters (DMM), DAQs, power supply, electronic load, spectrum analyzer, source measurement unit.

We are driven by our vision of being the preferred manufacturer, electrical systems integrator and worldwide service company by providing our clients with value\-added solutions that power their lives.


**About Us**



At Electronic Power Design, Inc. (EPD), we don't just build electrical equipment—we power industries and change lives. Our mission is to deliver top\-quality electrical solutions while fostering an environment where employees thrive. We believe in innovation, collaboration, and empowering our people to reach their full potential.


**The Opportunity**



EPD is seeking a motivated and technically skilled **Field Services Engineer** to join our growing Field Services team. This role is responsible for installing, commissioning, troubleshooting, maintaining, and supporting electrical power distribution systems at customer locations throughout the United States and internationally.



This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, traveling to customer sites, and working directly with customers to ensure reliable operation of mission\-critical electrical equipment.


**What You'll Do**


**Field Engineering \& Technical Support**


* Install, commission, test, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain electrical power distribution systems.
* Diagnose and resolve issues involving switchboards, motor control centers, generators, PLCs, VFDs, protective relays, breakers, and automation systems.
* Analyze system performance and recommend corrective actions to improve reliability and minimize downtime.
* Read and interpret electrical schematics, technical drawings, and engineering documentation.


**Customer Service \& Project Support**


* Serve as a professional representative of EPD at customer locations.
* Communicate technical findings, recommendations, and project updates with customers and project stakeholders.
* Provide customer training and operational guidance as needed.
* Build strong customer relationships through exceptional service and professionalism.


**Safety \& Compliance**


* Follow OSHA, NFPA 70E, customer site requirements, and EPD safety policies.
* Utilize proper PPE and safe electrical work practices.
* Maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas while promoting a culture of safety.


**Documentation \& Continuous Improvement**


* Complete service reports, commissioning documentation, startup records, and technical reports.
* Document troubleshooting activities and recommended corrective actions.
* Participate in technical training, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support manufacturing and engineering teams when not assigned to field service projects.


**What You Bring**


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline.
* 0–2 years of engineering experience; internships and co\-op experience welcomed.
* Knowledge of electrical power systems and industrial controls.
* Ability to read electrical schematics, technical drawings, and engineering documentation.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
* Willingness to travel up to 80% domestically and internationally.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with electrical commissioning, startup, or field service.
* Familiarity with switchboards, motor control centers, generators, PLCs, VFDs, and protective relays.
* Knowledge of OSHA regulations, NFPA 70E, and electrical safety practices.
* Experience in industrial manufacturing, renewable energy, utilities, or power generation.
* First Aid/CPR certification.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus.


**Physical Requirements**


* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.
* Ability to safely lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to lift bulky or awkward materials with or without assistance.
* Ability to work in varying indoor and outdoor environments, including heat and cold.
* Ability to travel extensively and work safely at customer facilities.


**Why Join EPD?**


**Work on Critical Infrastructure**



Support projects that power industrial facilities, manufacturing plants, energy operations, and critical infrastructure.


**Accelerate Your Engineering Career**



Gain hands\-on experience with complex electrical systems while developing valuable field engineering expertise.


**Travel \& Professional Growth**



Work in diverse environments and gain exposure to advanced electrical technologies and customer applications.


**Collaborative Culture**



Join a team that values safety, innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement.


**Competitive Compensation \& Benefits**



EPD offers competitive compensation, professional development opportunities, travel experience, and a comprehensive employee benefits package.


**Ready to Power the Future?**



If you're an engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, working directly with customers, and making a measurable impact in the field, we encourage you to apply and become part of the EPD Field Services team. Add job description when creating a specific template.

jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Electrical Engineering Manager
\_\_


ABB is seeking a Senior Lead Electrical Engineer to serve as the technical authority for Protection \& Controls and Power System Studies within our Automation Energy Industries division in Houston, TX. In this role, you will lead the technical direction of complex projects, define protection philosophies, drive engineering standards, mentor a growing team of engineers, and develop a well\-rounded understanding of modern power infrastructure up to 69kV.


Our group delivers substation design, protection and controls engineering, power system studies, and power management systems across medium and high voltage infrastructure. This is an opportunity to shape how we approach critical power system challenges, collaborate across disciplines, and leave a lasting impact on modern energy infrastructure

  

The work model for the role is: Hybrid (\#LI\-Hybrid)  

  

This role contributes to the Automation Energy Industries division in Houston, TX.  

  

Responsibilities:

* Serve as subject matter expert by leading Protection \& Controls engineering across multiple projects — including the definition of protection philosophies, relay selection, settings development, configuration, coordination, and review of single line diagrams — while providing technical oversight and standards to the engineering team.
* Perform and review power system studies ranging from standard analyses (short circuit, load flow, protective device coordination, arc flash) to advanced studies (dynamic stability, harmonics, transient analysis, grounding, motor starting, frequency response, voltage stability, and generator synchronization).
* Investigate and analyze power system disturbances, equipment failures, and protective relay operations at customer facilities.
* Review engineering deliverables to ensure technical accuracy, consistency, and compliance with industry standards, project specifications, and internal engineering practices.
* Mentor team members on protection and control best practices, building technical capability within the group.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders to support project execution and technical decision\-making.
* Support substation and electrical building integration design packages from conceptual stage through construction completion *(scope varies based on experience)*.
* Support the design and implementation of power management systems (PMS) *(scope varies based on experience).*

  



**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university and Professional Engineer (PE) license.
* 15\+ years of experience in power systems engineering, with significant depth in Protection \& Controls for medium and high voltage systems.
* Expert\-level knowledge of protection principles, relay coordination, protection scheme design, and proven ability to independently perform relay configuration and settings development (e.g., SEL, GE, Siemens, ABB, or similar platforms).
* Ability to lead and execute power system studies independently — from standard analyses (SC, LF, PC, AF) through advanced studies (dynamic stability, harmonics, transient analysis, grounding, motor starting, and voltage stability).
* Expert\-level proficiency with at least one major power system analysis software (e.g., ETAP, SKM PowerTools, EasyPower, PSCAD, or similar).
* Strong understanding of relevant industry standards and codes (IEEE, NFPA, NEC, ANSI, IEC, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with substation design, electrical building integration, and/or power management systems (PMS/SCADA) is considered an asset.
* Excellent technical problem\-solving, communication, documentation skills, and ability to mentor junior engineers.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Data Solutions), AI & Data Platforms (AiDP)
jobs.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS\&T) organization. IS\&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2\.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS\&T makes the impossible feel effortless. Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.  

  

AI \& Data Platforms (AiDP) is IS\&T's engine for AI\-powered innovation. The team brings together data, application development, and machine learning \- including generative AI \- along with data services and customer success functions, to help IS\&T build solutions more efficiently and streamline the adoption and embedding of generative AI across Apple.  

  

**Description**  

  

We engineer high\-quality, scalable and resilient distributed systems on cloud that power data exploration, analytics, reporting and production models. Our core systems are diverse and come with an unusual intersection of high data volumes with systems distributed across cloud and on\-premise infrastructure.  

  

This role will build solutions that integrate open source software with Apple’s internal ecosystem. You will drive development of new components and features from concept to release: design, build, test, and ship at a regular cadence. You will work closely with internal customers to understand their requirements and workflows, and propose new features and ecosystem changes to streamline their experience of using the solutions on our platform.  

  

This is a challenging software engineering role, where a large part of an engineer's time is spent in writing code and designing/developing applications on cloud, with the remainder being spent on tuning and debugging codebase, supporting production applications and supporting our application end users. This role requires in\-depth knowledge of innovative technologies and cloud data platform with the ability to independently learn new technologies and contribute to the success of various initiatives.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

3 or more years of experience building enterprise\-level data applications on distributed systems  

  

Hands\-on experience in designing and development of cloud\-based applications that include compute services, database services, APIs to design RESTful services, ETL, queues and notification services.  

  

Experience in cloud data warehousing platforms like Snowflake is highly valued  

  

Experience developing Big Data applications using Java, Spark, Kafka is a huge plus  

  

Understanding of fundamentals of object\-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, and problem solving  

  

Cloud technology experience on platforms like AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud  

  

Data Visualization Tools: experience in software such as Streamlit, Superset, Tableau, Business Objects, and Looker  

  

Data Insights and KPIs: Working experience on generating and visualizing data insights, metrics, and KPIs. Usage of basic ML models in the space of anomaly detection, forecasting, GenAI.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

Knowledge of BI concepts and implementation experience on Cloud with databases like Snowflake or Big Query  

  

Programming experience in building high\-quality software with at\-least one of the following programming languages \- Python, Scala or Java.  

  

Experience in developing highly optimized SQLs, procedures \& semantic process for distributed data applications.  

  

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $225,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  

  

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

Supporting 2\.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS\&T makes the impossible feel effortless. Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.  

  

AI \& Data Platforms (AiDP) is IS\&T's engine for AI\-powered innovation. The team brings together data, application development, and machine learning \- including generative AI \- along with data services and customer success functions, to help IS\&T build solutions more efficiently and streamline the adoption and embedding of generative AI across Apple.  

  

**Description**  

  

We engineer high\-quality, scalable and resilient distributed systems on cloud that power data exploration, analytics, reporting and production models. Our core systems are diverse and come with an unusual intersection of high data volumes with systems distributed across cloud and on\-premise infrastructure.  

  

This role will build solutions that integrate open source software with Apple’s internal ecosystem. You will drive development of new components and features from concept to release: design, build, test, and ship at a regular cadence. You will work closely with internal customers to understand their requirements and workflows, and propose new features and ecosystem changes to streamline their experience of using the solutions on our platform.  

  

This is a challenging software engineering role, where a large part of an engineer's time is spent in writing code and designing/developing applications on cloud, with the remainder being spent on tuning and debugging codebase, supporting production applications and supporting our application end users. This role requires in\-depth knowledge of innovative technologies and cloud data platform with the ability to independently learn new technologies and contribute to the success of various initiatives.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

3 or more years of experience building enterprise\-level data applications on distributed systems  

  

Hands\-on experience in designing and development of cloud\-based applications that include compute services, database services, APIs to design RESTful services, ETL, queues and notification services.  

  

Experience in cloud data warehousing platforms like Snowflake is highly valued  

  

Experience developing Big Data applications using Java, Spark, Kafka is a huge plus  

  

Understanding of fundamentals of object\-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, and problem solving  

  

Cloud technology experience on platforms like AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud  

  

Data Visualization Tools: experience in software such as Streamlit, Superset, Tableau, Business Objects, and Looker  

  

Data Insights and KPIs: Working experience on generating and visualizing data insights, metrics, and KPIs. Usage of basic ML models in the space of anomaly detection, forecasting, GenAI.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

Knowledge of BI concepts and implementation experience on Cloud with databases like Snowflake or Big Query  

  

Programming experience in building high\-quality software with at\-least one of the following programming languages \- Python, Scala or Java.  

  

Experience in developing highly optimized SQLs, procedures \& semantic process for distributed data applications.  

  

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $225,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  

  

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

***Job Title:*** Manager, Systems Engineering

***Job Code:*** *44524*

***Job Location:*** *S**alt Lake City, UT*

***Job Schedule:*** 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days\- totaling 80 hours worked\- and have every other Friday off

**Job Description:**


L3Harris Spectrum Superiority (S2\) is seeking a **Manager, Systems Engineering** to lead an engineering team supporting Electronic Warfare (EW) and the Next Generation Jammer (NGJ) program. This L5 leader will manage technical execution for assigned program scope and ensure the team delivers high\-quality systems engineering products through development, integration, test, fielding, and sustainment.


The Manager, Systems Engineering will report to an L6 Senior Manager, Systems Engineering, and will work closely with Program Management, Chief Engineers, customers, and functional engineering teams. The role includes team leadership, EW system architecture support, requirements management, technical planning, design and development oversight, integration and test execution, risk management, and technical staffing and mentoring for the NGJ program.

**Essential Functions:**

* Manage and develop a systems engineering team supporting assigned EW and NGJ program scope, including resource assignment, work prioritization, employee development, and performance management.
* Execute assigned technical work under the direction of the L6 Senior Manager, Systems Engineering, partnering with Program Management, customer stakeholders, and Chief Engineers to meet NGJ program objectives, EW mission needs, schedule, budget, and contractual requirements.
* Provide systems engineering leadership across the assigned EW system life cycle, including concept development, architecture, requirements analysis, design synthesis, integration, verification, validation, qualification, deployment, and operational support.
* Contribute to system architectures and technical roadmaps for EW, electronic attack, RF, and airborne mission\-system capabilities, including NGJ growth and modernization efforts.
* Oversee requirements decomposition, allocation, traceability, and verification planning across RF hardware, software, firmware, networking, and subsystem interfaces.


Oversee subcontractor requirements decomposition, statements of work, design, verification, and validation activities.

* Ensure development of high\-quality technical artifacts including specifications, interface control documents, test plans, procedures, verification cross\-reference matrices, and other customer deliverables.
* Lead assigned internal and external technical reviews, customer briefings, milestone assessments, and NGJ program status reviews; elevate significant technical risks and decisions to the L6 Senior Manager.
* Drive technical risk identification, mitigation planning, issue resolution, and opportunity management across assigned NGJ development and production efforts.
* Coordinate cross\-functional engineering execution among systems, RF, electrical, software, mechanical, test, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain teams.
* Support proposal strategy, basis\-of\-estimate development, technical volume creation, technical interchange meetings, and customer demonstrations for EW, NGJ, and related classified mission pursuits.
* Implement disciplined systems engineering processes, tools, and metrics to ensure technical quality, configuration control, and compliance with company and customer standards.
* Lead staffing, mentoring, succession planning, and development of a high\-performing systems engineering team supporting NGJ and other EW programs.
* Active Secret clearance required with the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance; ability to access additional classified programs as required.
* 

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or another relevant engineering or technical discipline and a minimum of 12 years of prior related experience, or a Graduate degree and a minimum of 10 years of prior related experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of technical leadership, functional leadership, or engineering management experience leading cross\-disciplinary teams on complex EW, defense, or aerospace programs.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Active Top Secret clearance preferred; TS/SCI eligibility or access is strongly desired.
* Demonstrated experience leading systems engineering for Electronic Warfare, electronic attack, RF, airborne mission systems, or other classified mission technologies; NGJ experience is strongly desired.
* Strong knowledge of systems engineering processes spanning EW mission requirements, architecture development, interface definition, integration, verification, validation, and qualification.
* Experience leading teams through complex customer engagements with DoD, IC, or other national security customers.
* Ability to guide technical strategy and investment planning for EW capabilities, including technology maturation, transition to production, and mission\-relevant roadmap development.
* Experience with risk management, earned value or schedule\-driven technical execution, and coordination across internal teams, subcontractors, and suppliers.

jobs.title: Senior Multidisciplinary Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job ID: 9537**  

**Date Posted: September 21, 2026**  

  

Join the Space Dynamics Laboratory (SDL) team, where you'll contribute to groundbreaking innovations! We are seeking applicants for a Systems Engineerto join our Strategic and Military Space Division.  

  

The Space Dynamics Laboratory (SDL) is seeking a motivated Multidisciplinary Systems Engineer.The successful candidate will play a key role in defining system architectures, coordinating interdisciplinary engineering efforts, managing requirements, risks, interfaces, and configurations, and ensuring cohesive technical execution across multiple teams. This role is ideal for candidates with a broad technical foundation across multiple engineering disciplines, strong analytical and communication skills, and a desire to contribute to team\-based problem\-solving in a dynamic, mission\-driven environment.  

  

The Strategic \& Military Space Division delivers advanced satellite and sensor systems that support the Department of Defense and the Intelligence Community. Our division is a key component of national security, providing technological solutions and expert mission support. Become part of a team dedicated to making a tangible contribution to our nation’s defense capabilities.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Leads or independently executes systems engineering activities throughout the system lifecycle, including requirements development, architecture, design, integration, verification, validation, and test
* Identifies and manages technical risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies
* Creates and maintains programmatic and technical documentation required for effective planning, execution, and technical reviews
* Coordinates engineering activities to ensure technical deliverables satisfy requirements and remain aligned with program objectives
* Provides systems engineering oversight of design, integration, verification, and test activities
* Advises Program Managers and engineering leadership on technical requirements, system impacts, risks, alternatives, and execution considerations
* Serves as a technical interface with customers, stakeholders, vendors, and subcontractors as appropriate
* Leads portions of technical reviews and support proposal and planning activities
* Provides technical guidance and mentoring to less\-experienced engineers
* Supports technical planning by providing inputs to program cost, schedule, staffing, and resource estimates

  

**Required Qualifications:*** Must be a US citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain US Government security clearance
* Bachelor’s in engineering or related science and 8\-15 years of relevant experience or a master’s and 6\-13 years of relevant experience
* Strong working knowledge of systems engineering processes across the system lifecycle
* Demonstrated experience with requirements development and verification, system architecture, interface management, risk management, configuration management, and trade studies
* Ability to evaluate technical alternatives and understand their impacts on system performance, cost, schedule, risk, and implementation
* Proficiency with systems engineering tools and analysis methods
* Ability to provide technical direction and influence engineering teams without requiring direct supervisory authority
* Experience supporting technical planning, cost estimating, and schedule development
* Strong organization and planning skills with the ability to manage multiple technical priorities
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain effective relationships with customers, stakeholders, and multidisciplinary teams
* Ability to travel as required

  

**Preferred Qualifications:*** Existing TS/SCI clearance
* Experience implementing Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools and processes
* Experience leading small\- to medium\-sized multidisciplinary engineering teams or technical efforts
* Experience with small satellite programs including risk mitigations, hardware development, and testing
* Understanding of the space environment

  

**Salary Range:*** $110,000\-$175,000
* This range serves as a general guideline and may vary based on factors such as role, level, location, market conditions, and individual qualifications, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. The range displayed in the job advertisement reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries across all US locations. Specific salary details for a candidate’s preferred location can be provided by the recruiter or HR manager during the hiring process.

 **Why Join SDL?**  

  

SDL offers competitive salaries and **a comprehensive benefits package**. Visit our **Benefits Page** to learn more about what we offer.  

  

SDL delivers advanced multi\-domain solutions to protect national security and enable scientific discovery. Our expertise in satellites, sensors and instruments, ground systems and data processing, and autonomous systems plays a critical role in missions supporting NASA and the Department of Defense. Join our team of engineers, scientists, technicians, and business professionals in our seventh decade of delivering mission success.  

  

At SDL, we strive to uphold a culture of respect, collaboration, empowerment, and accountability. We listen with open minds, seek to understand diverse perspectives, and engage in thoughtful dialogue. We work together by sharing knowledge, involving others, and offering support. We trust and empower our team members to take ownership, act with integrity, and be accountable. Above all, we deliver on our commitments to each other and to our mission partners.

**About Decision Technologies, Inc.**


Decision Technologies was founded to help bridge the gap between Department of Defense and Federal Government acquisition programs and technology to help our customers optimize their decision\-making process. Over the years, our areas of expertise have expanded to include Systems Engineering, Program Management, In\-Service Engineering, Equipment Repair, Research and Development, Test and Evaluation, and Intelligence and Counterintelligence Support. Our company culture cultivates talented problem\-solvers on focused on performance with industry\-leading teamwork and responsiveness. We have established a reputation for offering superior services and solutions, proven integrity and innovation, employee engagement and development, and customer collaboration.


Bring your expertise and knowledge to our team!

  

Bring the big picture together at the core of naval air and missile defense. As a Junior Combat Systems Engineer supporting the Navy’s Terminal Defense Systems program office, you will be the connective tissue between complex radars, guided missiles, automated launchers, and warship command\-and\-control architectures.

  

We are seeking a qualified **Junior Combat Systems Engineer** in **Arlington, VA**. This position is not eligible for hybrid or remote work situations. This is a 100% on\-site, in\-office position.

 **Position Description:**


Instead of focusing on just one isolated component, you will look across entire multi\-element combat weapon suites (such as Aegis and the Ship Self Defense System) to analyze requirements, map out digital architectures, define critical system interfaces, and verify performance through modeling, simulation, and live fleet testing. Working alongside senior systems architects and test directors, you will apply modern engineering methodologies to ensure diverse defensive technologies operate together seamlessly in high\-stress, real\-world operational environments.

 **Responsibilities and Duties:**

* + **Combat System Architecture \& Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE):** Build and maintain digital system\-of\-systems models using SysML and tools like Cameo/MagicDraw. Map operational requirements down to functional behaviors and software/hardware components, creating integrated digital architectures that demonstrate how terminal defense systems communicate across shipboard combat networks.

	+ **System Requirements Analysis \& Traceability:** Analyze and decompose top\-level warfighter needs and threat baselines into clear, testable system and subsystem performance requirements using tools like DOORS. Track requirements traceability across the entire systems development lifecycle to evaluate readiness and identify functional gaps.
	+ **Fire Control Loop \& Engagement Integration:** Analyze end\-to\-end fire control loops from initial target detection, tracking, and combat system designation, to launcher positioning, missile fly\-out, and terminal intercept. Review firing policies, weapon scheduling rules, and battle management logic to eliminate response latency and maximize overall probability of kill ().
	+ **Modeling \& Simulation (M\&S) Studies:** Run and evaluate digital system\-level simulations using MATLAB, Python, or specialized defense simulation frameworks. Analyze multi\-target engagement runs, sensor fusion performance, and system behavior under complex raid scenarios to inform tactical baselines and engineering trade studies.
	+ **Test \& Evaluation (T\&E) and Live Range Support:** Participate in end\-to\-end test planning, execution, and data analysis for land\-based integration test sites and live\-fire at\-sea missile events. Evaluate test scenarios, verify requirement compliance against objective test data, and review post\-test system telemetry to validate digital models against real hardware performance.

**Position Overview:**


We are seeking a skilled and motivated Electrical Design Engineer II to join our engineering team in Roanoke, Virginia. This role is essential to support the Commercial, Manufacturing, and Field Service teams with electrical designs for fixed and mobile equipment used in the civil explosives industry. The initial focus of the position is low\-voltage DC circuit design, control panel layouts, and electrical CAD modeling and drafting on both new and legacy systems. As the role matures, scope will expand to include AC power distribution for fixed plant equipment and light PLC/HMI programming. The successful candidate will follow designs through the entire lifecycle \- working with the Commercial team on concept designs and specifications, Manufacturing on production and sustaining activities, and Field Service to provide comprehensive end\-user support. This position is ideal for an engineer with 2\-5 years of experience who is ready to take ownership of electrical systems on complex mobile and fixed equipment.

* Generate test plans to qualify and validate new electrical designs, including panel point\-to\-point checkout, continuity and insulation checks, and functional testing

jobs.title: Systems Engineer, Controls Fleet, Data Center Capacity Delivery
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you experienced in managing Windows and Linux systems with a passion for building highly\-available infrastructure at massive scale? Join us in driving cloud innovation and automation, deploying mission\-critical systems that power global operations.  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services designs, delivers, and operates the global infrastructure that keeps AWS running. We manage the critical data center components \- from servers and networking to power and cooling \- that ensure continuous service for our customers. Within this organization, the Controls Fleet team builds and supports critical infrastructure services that power the world's premier e\-commerce and cloud computing environments.
  

  

We are seeking a passionate and motivated Systems Engineer to join our team of Windows and Linux experts. In this role, you'll deploy infrastructure and build automated solutions across our growing environment. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Windows Server administration and Linux systems, hands\-on experience with automation and scripting (PowerShell, Python, or Bash), and solid understanding of networking and distributed systems. Strong communication and documentation skills are essential, as you'll be collaborating closely with global teams. We value candidates who solve complex technical challenges through root cause analysis, can adapt to a fast\-paced environment, and effectively communicate technical concepts. You'll make an impact by deploying and managing critical infrastructure, creating automated solutions for large\-scale deployments, collaborating with teams to improve system reliability, and implementing solutions to technical challenges.  

  

You will be working in a hyper\-growth environment where priorities shift quickly. You must be flexible and adapt well to a wide range of tasks and technologies.  

  

At Amazon, it is expected that your technical knowledge demonstrates both depth and breadth. Leveraging the strengths of individual team members as peers and delegating tasks appropriately within the group for long term projects will all be critical tasks for this role. Deep knowledge of the domain and is sought after as a thought\-leader across the organization. If you are passionate about technology, excited by the prospect of working in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment, and driven to solve complex problems, we would love to hear from you.  

  

Minimal Travel Required. You are expected to be onsite at a minimum five days a week.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* IT Infrastructure: Deploy, manage, and support large\-scale Windows and Linux environments, including virtualization platforms and networking components
* Automation \& Development: Create and maintain automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, or Bash, focusing on scalable deployment processes and infrastructure management
* Cloud Services: Work with AWS or similar cloud platforms to support hybrid infrastructure environments
* System Design: Architect and implement secure, scalable solutions while considering system interdependencies and limitations
* Problem Solving: Analyze complex technical issues and develop effective solutions through root cause analysis
* Documentation \& Training: Create and maintain technical documentation, develop training materials, and support team knowledge sharing
* Collaboration: Work effectively with global teams, provide technical consultation, and support cross\-functional projects
* Security \& Compliance: Identify security risks, develop mitigation plans, and participate in compliance efforts
* Operational Support: Available for 24/7 on\-call rotation and up to 20% travel

  

About the team  

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.\-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and Instagram.

  

**Welcome to BWXT**

  

  

We believe in empowering our employees and cultivating a dynamic workplace that fosters growth and collaboration. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you'll find opportunities to challenge yourself, learn from seasoned experts, and contribute to nuclear innovation. We require a diverse range of skills to support our work in the markets that drive our business and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and life stages who are passionate about making a difference.  



**Location:** On\-site in Lynchburg, Virginia

  

**Your Day to Day as a Software Engineer:**


As a Software Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, build, and support of new and existing custom automated manufacturing and inspection systems used in the Lynchburg manufacturing facility. The selected candidate will perform software development for both new and existing applications and automated systems.


* Work cooperatively with teams of engineers (mechanical, electrical and software) and internal customers to design, build, maintain, and upgrade custom automated process control and data acquisition systems that support manufacturing, quality control, and other plant operations.
* Develop software applications for automated equipment/systems including motion control, data acquisition, databases interactions, and operator interfaces using .Net or CVI on Windows based platforms.
* Develop vision system and other post inspection analysis applications.
* Integrate applications/systems with third\-party hardware and software.
* Generate and execute system and software test plans and develops user manuals for the system/machine.
* Support engineers and technicians in the assembly, installation, trouble\-shooting, maintenance, and upgrade of new and existing systems.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in an Engineering or Computer Science if granted through a college of engineering AND four (4\) years of relevant experience is required.
* Must have demonstrable knowledge of, or be willing to develop, the following software skills:
	+ VB, C\#, C
	+ Motion Control (Delta Tau/Omron, Galil, Rockwell)
	+ Image Analysis (National Instruments, Halcon, Matrox)
	+ Git, TFS/Azure Devops
* Additional knowledge or previous experience in software development and/or with automation/automated equipment/systems is a plus.
* Must possess strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Must be highly self\-motivated and directed, with keen attention to detail.
* Must be able to work in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment.
* Must be a US Citizen.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) clearance.
  

**What We Offer:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.
* Professional development opportunities, including mentorship programs and sponsorship for continuing education.
* An inclusive atmosphere that celebrates new perspectives and supports collaboration between different generations.
* The chance to be part of a mission\-driven organization making a positive impact on the future of energy.
* Opportunities for continuous learning and training to grow throughout your career!

jobs.description:

At Carter Machinery, we don’t just offer jobs \- we offer long\-term careers defined by purpose, innovation, and impact. We’ve built an award\-winning workplace where high achievers thrive, careers grow, and your work truly matters.



Our legacy is strong, our vision is bold, and our future is built on investing in the growth and well\-being of our people. Whether you're turning a wrench, managing operations, or supporting customers, you play a vital role in powering industries that moves the world forward.


**Job Title:** Control Systems Engineer


**Location:** Richmond, Virginia


**Starting Compensation Range:** $79,000 \- $101,000 per year



The Control Systems Engineer is crucial in designing, developing, installing, and maintaining equipment used for monitoring and controlling facilities (BMS) systems, microgrids, machinery, and SWGR across many different Power System Applications, including industrial controls, power controls, protection, and EV control systems. The individual in this role is responsible for planning, designing/engineering, coordinating and working with project leads to ensure development and implementation of efficient control operations and cost\-effective systems to meet current and future needs of the organization.


**Requirements for the Control Systems Engineer position includes:**


* Proficiency in computer\-aided design (CAD) software for electrical system design, simulation tools for modeling and analysis, and programming languages commonly used in microgrid control systems
* PLC programming and HMI software development
* Familiarity with microgrids' control systems and automation technologies, such as supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems, energy management systems (EMS), Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs), Human Machine Interfaces (HMIs), Remote Terminal Units (RTUs)
* Must be very familiar with Protection \& Control design concepts
* Must be able to understand customers’ goals and work in partnership with all stakeholders to design control solutions
* Strong working knowledge in relay logic and wiring diagrams
* Strong leadership skills and commitment to teamwork
* Self\-starter able to work with limited supervision
* Must be able to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions
* Must be able to handle large volumes of work in a fast\-paced environment
* Must be able to multi\-task while maintaining organized and detailed documentation of all conversations
* Must possess a strong sense of urgency and a desire to exceed customer expectations
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Must be able to engage in effective and persuasive discussions on complex topics with leadership and other company personnel
* Clean driving record and a valid driver's license, required
* Frequent travel is required – overnight or out town via car or airplane
* Promote a positive customer experience
* Uphold the Core Values of Integrity, Commitment, Excellence and Teamwork by embracing The Carter Way


**Seeking Candidates with:**


* Minimum of seven years' industrial/electrical power system and controls design experience; other similar industries will be considered
* Prior experience with Protection \& Control design concepts, including one\-lines, three\-lines, schematics, wiring, etc.
* Experience in Panel and Shop Drawing design
* Experience in installing and maintaining SCADA equipment, PLC’s and communication circuits
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or electrical engineering technology from an accredited institution


**Physical Requirements:**


* Required to sit and talk or hear
* Frequently required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms
* Occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision and ability to adjust focus


**Competitive Compensation and Benefits:**


* Health, dental and vision insurance
* Paid time off
* 401(k), $0\.75 to $1\.25 match up to 6%
* Life and disability insurance
* In\-house training instructors/programs
* Tuition reimbursement
* Employee referral bonus program
* Tool allowances and tool loans
* Discounts on cellular phone service, computers, and vehicles
* Opportunities for overtime
* Shift differential (if applicable)


You’ll gain access to real learning, real advancement, and a real future in a company that’s reshaping what it means to lead in our industry. If you're looking for purpose, possibilities, and a team that wins together \- you belong at Carter Machinery.


***Come build what matters and build your future with us.***

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Description:

Markon is seeking a Junior Software Engineer to support an Intelligence Community client in McLean, Virginia. This position will design, develop, integrate, test, deploy, and maintain mission\-focused software applications across Sponsor networks and cloud environments. The Software Engineer will work throughout the full Agile software development lifecycle, supporting application enhancements, software integrations, APIs, reusable libraries, testing, and operational reliability.
Responsibilities:
* Develop and modify application source code in response to new requirements and requests for change.
* Provide application bug fixes, enhancements, and Graphical User Interface (GUI) improvements to meet operational requirements.
* Develop and deploy software applications across Sponsor environments, including cloud\-based environments.
* Design and develop Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs.
* Integrate externally developed code into core software libraries.
* Install and configure application software.
* Evaluate third\-party vendors and software partners.
* Maintain the design and architecture of software libraries, including module APIs, code organization, and compliance with established coding standards.
* Emphasize modularity, reusable code, clean interfaces between subsystems, and overall design integrity.
* Coordinate with configuration management personnel to integrate externally developed software into core software libraries.
* Develop a wide range of software for deployment on Sponsor networks.
* Develop and support software libraries involving technologies such as audio/video, image\-processing algorithms, operating systems and file systems, and device drivers.
* Assist the Sponsor in developing standards, methods, and procedures for determining product quality, release readiness, and software acceptance.
* Conduct testing throughout all levels of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Perform regression testing and adhere to established testing procedures.
* Support Agile software development practices throughout the full application lifecycle.
* Track and manage software issues using tools such as JIRA.
* Provide metrics on software availability and reliability during monthly status reviews.


Qualifications:
**Required:*** An Active TS/SCI with a FS Polygraph is required to be considered.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or another related scientific or technical discipline.
* Minimum of 2 years of software engineering experience within the last 5 years.
* Demonstrated experience with at least 3 of the following technologies:
	+ .NET.
	+ Visual Basic.
	+ Java.
	+ JavaScript.
	+ Tomcat.
	+ SQL.
	+ XML.
	+ Python.
	+ HTML.
	+ LDAP certificates.
	+ Apache.
	+ Ruby.
* Collectively, the team must demonstrate experience across all of the technologies listed above.
* Demonstrated experience supporting full\-lifecycle Agile software development projects.
* Demonstrated experience with software issue\-tracking tools such as JIRA.

**Desired:*** Demonstrated experience developing Android applications.
* Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining applications within AWS/Sponsor cloud computing environments.
* Working knowledge of GIS software, including Google Maps and Google Earth.
* Demonstrated experience with Continuous Software Development and Software Integration best practices.
* Experience working with Information Security (INFOSEC) and Information Assurance (IA) policies, including ICD 503, to support system security and data integrity.
* Demonstrated experience implementing the complete DevOps lifecycle, including:
	+ Build pipeline integration.
	+ Automated deployments.
	+ Compliance scanning.
	+ Test\-driven development.


Salary Range: USD $140,000\.00 \- USD $170,000\.00 /Yr.  

  

The Markon pay range for this position is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. Eager to join a team where your skills are valued, your growth is nurtured, and your impact is profound? Look no further than Markon, a premier consulting firm deeply dedicated to advancing our nation's most critical missions.  

At Markon, we don't just offer jobs – we offer opportunities for personal and professional transformation. Empowering our employees to lead, innovate, and excel, we foster an environment where new ideas are not just welcomed but celebrated. As a perennial Washington Post Top Workplace, we prioritize the well\-being and success of our team members, ensuring they can bring their best selves to work.  

Headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, Markon has garnered national recognition for our unwavering dedication to excellence in serving the intelligence community, as well as federal civilian and defense agencies. Our growing reach extends across 17 states, 116 countries, and 5 continents, where our team of dynamic professionals collaborates to deliver unparalleled program and project management services.

Are you a hands\-on engineer who loves bringing microcontrollers to life, tracing circuit boards, and making things fly? If you’ve spent your degree, capstones, or weekend projects tinkering with STM32s, ESP32s, or Arduinos—digging into logic analyzers and troubleshooting hardware\-software interfaces— **Airbus** has the ideal runway for your career.


We are seeking an enthusiastic **Entry\-Level Embedded Software Engineer** to join our Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) team. In this role, you won't just write abstract code behind a desk—you will be on the bench and in the lab, working directly on the hardware/software boundary of our next\-generation autonomous aircraft and ground equipment. From writing C/C\+\+ firmware and configuring low\-level communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN) to bench testing with oscilloscopes and supporting hardware bring\-up, your work will directly power physical, flying systems.  



  

**Meet the Team:**

The Airbus Helicopters Flexrotor Program offers one of the most advanced small tactical unmanned aerial systems (STUAS) with vertical take\-off and landing (VTOL). It can be used day or night by US and allied forces for a diverse range of intelligence, surveillance, target acquisition and reconnaissance (ISTAR) on land and at sea.  



  

**Your Working Environment:**

Nestled in the heart of the stunning Columbia River Gorge in Bingen, WA, our workplace offers innovation and the ability to contribute to game\-changing solutions while enjoying the flexibility to spread your wings. Whether it's solving complex challenges, or celebrating victories, you’ll be part of a cohesive crew that thrives on innovation and the beauty that the Pacific Northwest has to offer!

Other duties as assigned by the manager

Required

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Test
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer, Test**
==================================

**About Tin Can**
-----------------


Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. We’re creating screen\-free, delightful devices and services that let families call the people who matter most, free from the noise of today’s digital world.


We’re building a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler \& better for their kids than the tech\-infused lives we’re currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it). As we gear up to scale to thousands of families, we’re ready to bring on an engineer to help make it happen.

**The Role**
------------


When a kid picks up a Tin Can, the call has to work the first time, every time — whether that’s a call to Grandma or a call to 911\. That promise is only as good as our ability to prove it holds before a release goes out. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Test to own that proof: the automated testing that verifies every call path works, on every change, before it reaches a kid’s phone.


You’ll own our end\-to\-end and call\-path test suites and the checks that gate a release. The surfaces are real: a staging environment where a change can place an actual SIP call before it merges; a Flutter app on iOS and Android; firmware on ESP32 devices; and a call\-decision engine whose scenario suite you’ll grow into our strongest safety net. You’ll work alongside our voice, app, infrastructure and firmware engineers, and you’ll be the person who defines what “tested” means here.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own our end\-to\-end and call\-path test suites — the automated checks that tell engineers a change is safe to ship
* Build automated SIP test calls that run in staging before every merge — real calls verified for connection, audio, voicemail, and the call record afterward
* Guarantee emergency calling with continuous, safe verification, so we can show that every Tin Can reaches 911
* Grow regression coverage across the paths families depend on most — voicemail, contact approval, missed calls — so every release protects them
* Automate the manual parts of our release process across mobile, backend, and firmware, so releases get faster and safer as the fleet grows
* Shape our CI/CD: what runs on every pull request, what gates a deploy, and what a failing check blocks
* Partner with firmware on repeatable release testing, and push on testability — device emulation, test hooks — so device behavior is verified automatically on every build
* Measure the suites themselves — coverage of the paths families use, signal engineers can trust, and defects caught before they ship

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5\+ years in software engineering, with deep experience in test automation for production systems where a failure is something a customer feels immediately
* You’ve built end\-to\-end suites engineers actually trust — fast, deterministic, wired into CI, and rare enough to be believed when they go red
* Comfortable in the guts of a distributed system; you can follow a request across services, read the telemetry, and write a test that proves behavior rather than restating the code
* Fluency using AI as a multiplier across diagnosis, analysis, and testing; this is how we work, not a nice\-to\-have
* A clear communicator who writes things down, because a test suite nobody understands is a test suite nobody maintains
* Hands\-on and scrappy; you’ll build the harness, the fixtures, and the CI plumbing yourself, and you’d rather automate a test than run it twice
* A collaborative, low\-ego approach — everyone here sweeps the floor
* Bonus: VoIP or telephony testing (SIP/RTP, sipp, synthetic call monitoring); mobile release testing across iOS and Android; or hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing for embedded devices

**Why Join Tin Can**
--------------------

* **We’re building tech that protects childhood:** We’re on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Growth
jobs.description:
**Software Engineer, Growth**
=============================

**About Tin Can**
-----------------


Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. We’re creating screen\-free, delightful devices and services that let families call the people who matter most, free from the noise of today’s digital world.


We’re building a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler \& better for their kids than the tech\-infused lives we’re currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it).

**The Role**
------------


Families meet Tin Can long before they hold one — on a landing page, in a friend’s text with a referral code, in an ad that made them smile. All of it is software. When it works, a family who wanted something better for their kids finds us; when a page breaks mid\-campaign or a promised referral credit never arrives, they don’t. We’re looking for a software engineer to own the systems behind how new families find Tin Can and decide to bring one home.


You’ll run our Shopify storefront, build our referral program, and own the services and APIs underneath both. You’ll build the tooling that lets growth marketers launch their own landing pages, and turn the integrations behind our storefront into systems we can test, watch, and reverse. You’ll collaborate with our growth and brand teams, and work with the engineers who own our app, voice platform, and account portal. Real money and real trust run through these systems, so you’ll go as deep as that asks.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own our Shopify storefront for acquisition — the launches and seasonal campaigns behind our biggest moments of the year
* Build our referral program end to end — invite moments, eligibility, reward fulfillment, and the identity and attribution data that makes us pay exactly once
* Own the integrations where an order becomes a customer, an activation, and a reward — the seams between platforms are where the money and the trust live
* Turn the glue behind our campaigns into services with owners, tests, alarms, and a rollback
* Build the self\-serve tooling that gets you out of the page\-building business — components, templates, version control, and monitoring, so growth marketing can publish on their own
* Build the digital half of our brand campaigns with our creative team — the sites and sign\-up flows behind the stories we want families to join
* Instrument what you ship, with the team that owns our experimentation platform, so a launch’s numbers can be trusted

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 4\+ years building and running customer\-facing web applications, with real ownership of what you shipped
* Strong TypeScript across the stack — you’ve built and run APIs in production (AWS Lambda, Cloudflare Workers, etc.)
* You’ve built integrations across third\-party platforms and think in idempotency and reconciliation, because events arrive twice, arrive late, and bring the same person back under two identities
* You prioritize testability, observability, and reliability
* You’ve built tools for non\-engineers so the people closest to a campaign don’t wait on you
* Platform judgment on commerce — what belongs inside Shopify, what belongs in a service you own, and what an integration’s credentials can reach
* Fluency using AI as a multiplier across prototyping, build, and analysis; this is how we work, not a nice\-to\-have
* You’ve worked toward campaign deadlines and know how to ship something excellent when the launch date genuinely can’t move, and you can take brand and design direction and make it look right
* A clear communicator who writes things down, and a collaborative, low\-ego approach — everyone here sweeps the floor
* **Bonus:** a referral, affiliate, or loyalty platform you integrated through its APIs, where the real work hid in identity, attribution, and reward fulfillment; Shopify theme, checkout, or app development; feature\-flag or lifecycle\-marketing tooling; an eye for craft; or growing a direct\-to\-consumer brand through real seasonal peaks

**Why Join Tin Can**
--------------------

* **We’re building tech that protects childhood:** We’re on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. No doomscrolling, data mining, or dopamine traps — just a simpler, better way for kids to stay in touch. This is a rare opportunity to build something that truly matters.
* **You’ll own the machine behind how families find us:** This is our first engineering role dedicated entirely to growth — the storefront, the referral program, and the systems underneath them are yours, including how we know they’re working.
* **Small, high\-trust team:** Every company says “team,” but at Tin Can it means something different. We’re a small, mission\-driven group that genuinely has each other’s backs — professionally and personally. You’ll be joining a tight\-knit crew where your ideas and instincts matter from day one.
* **Room to explore, not just execute:** You’ll have the space to challenge assumptions, solve hard problems, and build systems that reflect our values of trust, simplicity, and care.


If you’re excited by the idea of building the systems that bring new families to Tin Can — and making them sturdy enough to carry the biggest week of our year — we’d love to meet you.


Compensation Range: $145K \- $175K
