new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Amazon's Robotics (AR) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy industrial robotics and automation technologies across North America's fulfillment network. In AR TD, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in A develop.
  

  

As a Systems Engineer in AR TD, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro\-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross\-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology \& Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third\-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on\-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon\-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go\-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel\-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.
  

  

\*\*Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi\-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high\-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi\-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end\-to\-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer.
  

You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.
  

  

* You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go\-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.
* You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)
* You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization
* You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade\-offs between time, quality, and resources
* You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.
* You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.
* You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains
* You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment
* You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results

  

A day in the life  

In this role you will be focused on execution of end\-to\-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day\-to\-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.

**Location**
------------


Austin, TX; New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA


**Employment Type**

Full time

On\-site


**Department**
--------------


Delivery


**Compensation**
----------------


* $164K – $206K • Offers Equity

*To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US\-based job postings. Our compensation package includes base salary, equity for all full time roles, benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans.*


*This range reflects a good\-faith estimate based on the applicable pay scale, the range previously established for this role, the compensation of individuals currently in equivalent positions, and/or the budgeted amount for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications, and other factors.*


*We welcome compensation discussions if this range doesn't meet your requirements. Outstanding candidates may be eligible for adjusted terms, plus meaningful equity that ensures you benefit directly from the company's long\-term performance.*


*Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.*


  
**About Fluidstack**
====================


We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built \- but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.  

  



We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them \- with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization\-scale infrastructure for AI.

  

  

**We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!**


**How We Operate**
==================


* **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.
* **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
* **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
* **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
* **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

**The Capacity Delivery Team**
------------------------------


**Examples of key problems the team is working on**


* **Engineer gigawatts from drawing to energized, in months not years.** Capacity Delivery owns technical execution across every build: the drawings, the field questions, and the engineering calls that keep multiple concurrent gigawatt sites moving.
* **Engineer data centers that go up in months, not years.** At that pace rework is not an option: problems get caught on paper or they cost a data hall.
* **Design it once, build it a hundred times.** Every site's lessons roll into the reference design on the way to 10s to 100s of GWs, so each build starts ahead of the last.

**Role Scope**
--------------


* Own controls engineering for assigned sites: BMS and EPMS design review, integration oversight, and commissioning support.
* Review controls submittals against the standard: architecture, points, sequences, graphics.
* Oversee integrator programming quality before it reaches the field.
* Support Level 3 through 5 commissioning with engineering answers in hours.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.
* You've engineered building or industrial controls on mission critical projects.
* You read and write sequences of operations.
* You've reviewed integrator work and sent it back with specifics.
* You debug controls issues from the points list up.
* Bonus: Niagara or Ignition. EPMS platforms. Networking for controls. Commissioning experience.

new_jobs.description:
**EPD Mission**



The mission of Electronic Power Design, Inc. is to craft quality electrical equipment for our clients and uphold a standard of excellence in the engineering, design and manufacturing process. We strive to improve the quality of life of our employees by creating a work environment conducive to personal development, success and fulfillment. We are driven by our vision of being the preferred manufacturer, electrical systems integrator and worldwide service company by providing our clients with value\-added solutions that power their lives.


**About Us**



At Electronic Power Design, Inc. (EPD), we don't just build electrical equipment—we power industries and change lives. Our mission is to deliver top\-quality electrical solutions while fostering an environment where employees thrive. We believe in innovation, collaboration, and empowering our people to reach their full potential.


**The Opportunity**



EPD is seeking a motivated and technically skilled **Field Services Engineer** to join our growing Field Services team. This role is responsible for installing, commissioning, troubleshooting, maintaining, and supporting electrical power distribution systems at customer locations throughout the United States and internationally.



This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, traveling to customer sites, and working directly with customers to ensure reliable operation of mission\-critical electrical equipment.


**What You'll Do**


**Field Engineering \& Technical Support**


* Install, commission, test, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain electrical power distribution systems.
* Diagnose and resolve issues involving switchboards, motor control centers, generators, PLCs, VFDs, protective relays, breakers, and automation systems.
* Analyze system performance and recommend corrective actions to improve reliability and minimize downtime.
* Read and interpret electrical schematics, technical drawings, and engineering documentation.


**Customer Service \& Project Support**


* Serve as a professional representative of EPD at customer locations.
* Communicate technical findings, recommendations, and project updates with customers and project stakeholders.
* Provide customer training and operational guidance as needed.
* Build strong customer relationships through exceptional service and professionalism.


**Safety \& Compliance**


* Follow OSHA, NFPA 70E, customer site requirements, and EPD safety policies.
* Utilize proper PPE and safe electrical work practices.
* Maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas while promoting a culture of safety.


**Documentation \& Continuous Improvement**


* Complete service reports, commissioning documentation, startup records, and technical reports.
* Document troubleshooting activities and recommended corrective actions.
* Participate in technical training, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support manufacturing and engineering teams when not assigned to field service projects.


**What You Bring**


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline.
* 0–2 years of engineering experience; internships and co\-op experience welcomed.
* Knowledge of electrical power systems and industrial controls.
* Ability to read electrical schematics, technical drawings, and engineering documentation.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
* Willingness to travel up to 80% domestically and internationally.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with electrical commissioning, startup, or field service.
* Familiarity with switchboards, motor control centers, generators, PLCs, VFDs, and protective relays.
* Knowledge of OSHA regulations, NFPA 70E, and electrical safety practices.
* Experience in industrial manufacturing, renewable energy, utilities, or power generation.
* First Aid/CPR certification.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus.


**Physical Requirements**


* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.
* Ability to safely lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to lift bulky or awkward materials with or without assistance.
* Ability to work in varying indoor and outdoor environments, including heat and cold.
* Ability to travel extensively and work safely at customer facilities.

**Work on Critical Infrastructure**



Support projects that power industrial facilities, manufacturing plants, energy operations, and critical infrastructure.


**Accelerate Your Engineering Career**



Gain hands\-on experience with complex electrical systems while developing valuable field engineering expertise.


**Travel \& Professional Growth**



Work in diverse environments and gain exposure to advanced electrical technologies and customer applications.


**Collaborative Culture**



Join a team that values safety, innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

EPD offers competitive compensation, professional development opportunities, travel experience, and a comprehensive employee benefits package.

If you're an engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, working directly with customers, and making a measurable impact in the field, we encourage you to apply and become part of the EPD Field Services team. Add job description when creating a specific template.

At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Electrical Engineering Manager
\_\_


ABB is seeking a Senior Lead Electrical Engineer to serve as the technical authority for Protection \& Controls and Power System Studies within our Automation Energy Industries division in Houston, TX. In this role, you will lead the technical direction of complex projects, define protection philosophies, drive engineering standards, mentor a growing team of engineers, and develop a well\-rounded understanding of modern power infrastructure up to 69kV.


Our group delivers substation design, protection and controls engineering, power system studies, and power management systems across medium and high voltage infrastructure. This is an opportunity to shape how we approach critical power system challenges, collaborate across disciplines, and leave a lasting impact on modern energy infrastructure

  

The work model for the role is: Hybrid (\#LI\-Hybrid)  

  

This role contributes to the Automation Energy Industries division in Houston, TX.  

  

Responsibilities:

* Serve as subject matter expert by leading Protection \& Controls engineering across multiple projects — including the definition of protection philosophies, relay selection, settings development, configuration, coordination, and review of single line diagrams — while providing technical oversight and standards to the engineering team.
* Perform and review power system studies ranging from standard analyses (short circuit, load flow, protective device coordination, arc flash) to advanced studies (dynamic stability, harmonics, transient analysis, grounding, motor starting, frequency response, voltage stability, and generator synchronization).
* Investigate and analyze power system disturbances, equipment failures, and protective relay operations at customer facilities.
* Review engineering deliverables to ensure technical accuracy, consistency, and compliance with industry standards, project specifications, and internal engineering practices.
* Mentor team members on protection and control best practices, building technical capability within the group.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders to support project execution and technical decision\-making.
* Support substation and electrical building integration design packages from conceptual stage through construction completion *(scope varies based on experience)*.
* Support the design and implementation of power management systems (PMS) *(scope varies based on experience).*

  



**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university and Professional Engineer (PE) license.
* 15\+ years of experience in power systems engineering, with significant depth in Protection \& Controls for medium and high voltage systems.
* Expert\-level knowledge of protection principles, relay coordination, protection scheme design, and proven ability to independently perform relay configuration and settings development (e.g., SEL, GE, Siemens, ABB, or similar platforms).
* Ability to lead and execute power system studies independently — from standard analyses (SC, LF, PC, AF) through advanced studies (dynamic stability, harmonics, transient analysis, grounding, motor starting, and voltage stability).
* Expert\-level proficiency with at least one major power system analysis software (e.g., ETAP, SKM PowerTools, EasyPower, PSCAD, or similar).
* Strong understanding of relevant industry standards and codes (IEEE, NFPA, NEC, ANSI, IEC, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with substation design, electrical building integration, and/or power management systems (PMS/SCADA) is considered an asset.
* Excellent technical problem\-solving, communication, documentation skills, and ability to mentor junior engineers.

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

new_jobs.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS\&T) organization. IS\&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2\.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS\&T makes the impossible feel effortless. Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.  

  

AI \& Data Platforms (AiDP) is IS\&T's engine for AI\-powered innovation. The team brings together data, application development, and machine learning \- including generative AI \- along with data services and customer success functions, to help IS\&T build solutions more efficiently and streamline the adoption and embedding of generative AI across Apple.  

  

**Description**  

  

We engineer high\-quality, scalable and resilient distributed systems on cloud that power data exploration, analytics, reporting and production models. Our core systems are diverse and come with an unusual intersection of high data volumes with systems distributed across cloud and on\-premise infrastructure.  

  

This role will build solutions that integrate open source software with Apple’s internal ecosystem. You will drive development of new components and features from concept to release: design, build, test, and ship at a regular cadence. You will work closely with internal customers to understand their requirements and workflows, and propose new features and ecosystem changes to streamline their experience of using the solutions on our platform.  

  

This is a challenging software engineering role, where a large part of an engineer's time is spent in writing code and designing/developing applications on cloud, with the remainder being spent on tuning and debugging codebase, supporting production applications and supporting our application end users. This role requires in\-depth knowledge of innovative technologies and cloud data platform with the ability to independently learn new technologies and contribute to the success of various initiatives.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

3 or more years of experience building enterprise\-level data applications on distributed systems  

  

Hands\-on experience in designing and development of cloud\-based applications that include compute services, database services, APIs to design RESTful services, ETL, queues and notification services.  

  

Experience in cloud data warehousing platforms like Snowflake is highly valued  

  

Experience developing Big Data applications using Java, Spark, Kafka is a huge plus  

  

Understanding of fundamentals of object\-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, and problem solving  

  

Cloud technology experience on platforms like AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud  

  

Data Visualization Tools: experience in software such as Streamlit, Superset, Tableau, Business Objects, and Looker  

  

Data Insights and KPIs: Working experience on generating and visualizing data insights, metrics, and KPIs. Usage of basic ML models in the space of anomaly detection, forecasting, GenAI.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

Knowledge of BI concepts and implementation experience on Cloud with databases like Snowflake or Big Query  

  

Programming experience in building high\-quality software with at\-least one of the following programming languages \- Python, Scala or Java.  

  

Experience in developing highly optimized SQLs, procedures \& semantic process for distributed data applications.  

  

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $225,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. L3Harris Spectrum Superiority (S2\) is seeking a **Manager, Systems Engineering** to lead an engineering team supporting Electronic Warfare (EW) and the Next Generation Jammer (NGJ) program. This L5 leader will manage technical execution for assigned program scope and ensure the team delivers high\-quality systems engineering products through development, integration, test, fielding, and sustainment.

* Manage and develop a systems engineering team supporting assigned EW and NGJ program scope, including resource assignment, work prioritization, employee development, and performance management.
* Execute assigned technical work under the direction of the L6 Senior Manager, Systems Engineering, partnering with Program Management, customer stakeholders, and Chief Engineers to meet NGJ program objectives, EW mission needs, schedule, budget, and contractual requirements.

* Contribute to system architectures and technical roadmaps for EW, electronic attack, RF, and airborne mission\-system capabilities, including NGJ growth and modernization efforts.
* Oversee requirements decomposition, allocation, traceability, and verification planning across RF hardware, software, firmware, networking, and subsystem interfaces.


Oversee subcontractor requirements decomposition, statements of work, design, verification, and validation activities.

* Ensure development of high\-quality technical artifacts including specifications, interface control documents, test plans, procedures, verification cross\-reference matrices, and other customer deliverables.
* Lead assigned internal and external technical reviews, customer briefings, milestone assessments, and NGJ program status reviews; elevate significant technical risks and decisions to the L6 Senior Manager.
* Drive technical risk identification, mitigation planning, issue resolution, and opportunity management across assigned NGJ development and production efforts.
* Coordinate cross\-functional engineering execution among systems, RF, electrical, software, mechanical, test, manufacturing, quality, and supply chain teams.
* Support proposal strategy, basis\-of\-estimate development, technical volume creation, technical interchange meetings, and customer demonstrations for EW, NGJ, and related classified mission pursuits.
* Implement disciplined systems engineering processes, tools, and metrics to ensure technical quality, configuration control, and compliance with company and customer standards.
* Lead staffing, mentoring, succession planning, and development of a high\-performing systems engineering team supporting NGJ and other EW programs.
* Active Secret clearance required with the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance; ability to access additional classified programs as required.
* 

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or another relevant engineering or technical discipline and a minimum of 12 years of prior related experience, or a Graduate degree and a minimum of 10 years of prior related experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of technical leadership, functional leadership, or engineering management experience leading cross\-disciplinary teams on complex EW, defense, or aerospace programs.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Active Top Secret clearance preferred; TS/SCI eligibility or access is strongly desired.
* Demonstrated experience leading systems engineering for Electronic Warfare, electronic attack, RF, airborne mission systems, or other classified mission technologies; NGJ experience is strongly desired.
* Strong knowledge of systems engineering processes spanning EW mission requirements, architecture development, interface definition, integration, verification, validation, and qualification.
* Experience leading teams through complex customer engagements with DoD, IC, or other national security customers.
* Ability to guide technical strategy and investment planning for EW capabilities, including technology maturation, transition to production, and mission\-relevant roadmap development.
* Experience with risk management, earned value or schedule\-driven technical execution, and coordination across internal teams, subcontractors, and suppliers.

* Bachelor’s in engineering or related science and 8\-15 years of relevant experience or a master’s and 6\-13 years of relevant experience
* Strong working knowledge of systems engineering processes across the system lifecycle
* Demonstrated experience with requirements development and verification, system architecture, interface management, risk management, configuration management, and trade studies
* Ability to evaluate technical alternatives and understand their impacts on system performance, cost, schedule, risk, and implementation

* Ability to provide technical direction and influence engineering teams without requiring direct supervisory authority

new_jobs.title: Senior RF Electrical Engineer
new_jobs.description:
HawkEye 360 is seeking a Sr. RF Electrical Engineer on the Space Team. The Space Team's mission is to design, build, and test small commercial satellites that provide revolutionary RF geospatial analytics.



You will perform RF and electrical design of our space platforms with a primary focus on our RF payloads. This includes RF front ends, integrating Software Defined Radios (SDR's) and antenna systems. You'll define and execute RF performance tests to verify mission requirements while also developing analog, digital, and power electronics across our satellite platforms. This role requires strong RF and Electrical Engineering expertise working cross functionally with the mechanical, software, payload, and systems engineering teams.


**Your main responsibilities will be:**


* Design and develop RF payload architectures and Software Defined Radio systems for space\-based RF collection missions.
* Design and optimize RF front ends, including filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, and signal conditioning circuitry.
* Perform electrical and RF simulations at a board and system level to validate the performance of different sub\-systems.
* Perform RF link budget analysis, interference modeling, and sensitivity trade studies to meet mission performance requirements.
* Support payload architecture decisions through mission\-driven trade studies at PDR/CDR milestones.
* Define and scope RF performance test plans to verify key specifications including sensitivity, dynamic range, spurious emissions, linearity, and signal quality.
* Develop test procedures and automation scripts to characterize SDR and RF front\-end performance.
* Execute EMI/EMC compliance testing and develop mitigation strategies for flight hardware.
* Design digital, analog, and power electronics for satellite flight hardware. Create and review schematics, block diagrams, PCB layouts, and Design for Manufacturing (DFM).
* Work closely with PCB Contract Manufacturers (CMs) to ensure quality control and timely delivery of flight hardware.
* Support spacecraft integration and testing efforts, including the design of Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE), flatsats for functional testing, and satellite flight hardware testing.
* Perform first article hardware unit testing, including reception inspection, burn\-in testing, thermal validation, and hardware checkouts.


**Your skills and qualifications:**  

**Essential education and experience:**


* Bachelor's degree in RF/Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Expert understanding of software\-defined radio architectures, RF front\-ends, and space\-based RF systems.
* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and testing RF electronics, including SDRs, mixers, filters, amplifiers, and receiver chains.
* Experience s using lab equipment such as Spectrum Analyzers, Network Analyzers, Signal Generators, Noise Figure Analyzers, and RF test chambers.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across multi\-disciplinary teams.
* Understanding of power electronics, high\-speed digital design, and RF fundamentals (impedance matching, S\-parameters, noise figure, linearity, etc.).
* Expertise in PCB design and layout (Altium or similar) with attention to RF design considerations (controlled impedance, grounding, shielding).
* Hands\-on flight hardware experience (satellite integration, RF lab testing, prototyping, troubleshooting).
* Experience handling ESD\-sensitive components and operating in cleanroom environments.


**Desirable:**


* Experience working in the smallsat or space industry with RF payloads or communication systems.
* Experience with version control (git) and continuous integration workflows.
* Proficiency with Python, C\+\+, MATLAB, or other coding languages for RF analysis and test automation.
* Experience with RF simulation tools (ADS, CST, HFSS, or similar).
* Familiarity with CAD (NX, SolidWorks, etc.) to support electro\-mechanical integration.
* Experience with EMI/EMC testing
* Experience using collaboration tools such as JIRA, Confluence, etc.

**Company Overview:**



HawkEye 360 is equipping defense, intelligence, and national security leaders with mission\-critical signals intelligence to enable faster, better decision making. By detecting, geolocating, and characterizing radio frequency emissions worldwide, HawkEye 360 delivers trusted domain awareness and early warning indicators to the US Government and allied partners. Our space\-based collection, proprietary signal processing, and AI\-powered analytics transform knowledge of RF spectrum into a strategic advantage. Proven by operational mission success, HawkEye 360 is redefining how signals intelligence strengthens national and global security.


*HawkEye 360 is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.*

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Electrical Design Engineer II to join our engineering team in Roanoke, Virginia. The initial focus of the position is low\-voltage DC circuit design, control panel layouts, and electrical CAD modeling and drafting on both new and legacy systems. As the role matures, scope will expand to include AC power distribution for fixed plant equipment and light PLC/HMI programming. The successful candidate will follow designs through the entire lifecycle \- working with the Commercial team on concept designs and specifications, Manufacturing on production and sustaining activities, and Field Service to provide comprehensive end\-user support. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Within AIS and Data Center Engineering, the Electrical Products and Services team is driving rapid innovation in electrical infrastructure used by AWS. Our designs are fundamentally changing the data center, providing operational and financial benefits that are critical to the success of the AWS business and its millions of customers. Our engineers solve challenging technology problems and take big bets on new concepts, enabling AWS services to continue to revolutionize the industry. AWS is seeking an Engineering Manager for our team developing new infrastructure solutions that enable at\-scale deployment of the latest liquid\-cooled racks into our data centers. This role will work closely with both AWS builders and third\-party manufacturers to develop infrastructure solutions on our behalf.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. A U.S.\-based company, BWXT is a Fortune 1000 and Defense News Top 100 manufacturing and engineering innovator that provides safe and effective nuclear solutions for global security, clean energy, environmental restoration, nuclear medicine and space exploration. With more than 7,800 employees, BWXT has 14 major operating sites in the U.S., Canada and the U.K. We are the sole manufacturer of naval nuclear reactors for U.S. submarines and aircraft carriers. Our company supplies precision manufactured components, services and fuel for the commercial nuclear power industry across four continents. Our joint ventures provide environmental restoration and operations management at a dozen U.S. Department of Energy and NASA facilities. BWXT’s technology is driving advances in medical radioisotope production in North America and microreactors for various defense and space applications. For more information, visit www.bwxt.com. Markon is seeking a Junior Software Engineer to support an Intelligence Community client in McLean, Virginia. This position will design, develop, integrate, test, deploy, and maintain mission\-focused software applications across Sponsor networks and cloud environments. * Perform regression testing and adhere to established testing procedures.
* Support Agile software development practices throughout the full application lifecycle.
* Track and manage software issues using tools such as JIRA.
* Provide metrics on software availability and reliability during monthly status reviews.

**Required:*** An Active TS/SCI with a FS Polygraph is required to be considered.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or another related scientific or technical discipline.
* Minimum of 2 years of software engineering experience within the last 5 years.

	+ Visual Basic.

	+ JavaScript.
	+ Tomcat.
	+ SQL.
	+ XML.
	+ Python.
	+ HTML.
	+ LDAP certificates.
	+ Apache.

* Demonstrated experience supporting full\-lifecycle Agile software development projects.
* Demonstrated experience with software issue\-tracking tools such as JIRA.

* Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining applications within AWS/Sponsor cloud computing environments.

* Experience working with Information Security (INFOSEC) and Information Assurance (IA) policies, including ICD 503, to support system security and data integrity.

	+ Test\-driven development.

The Airbus Helicopters Flexrotor Program offers one of the most advanced small tactical unmanned aerial systems (STUAS) with vertical take\-off and landing (VTOL). It can be used day or night by US and allied forces for a diverse range of intelligence, surveillance, target acquisition and reconnaissance (ISTAR) on land and at sea.

Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. We’re creating screen\-free, delightful devices and services that let families call the people who matter most, free from the noise of today’s digital world.


We’re building a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler \& better for their kids than the tech\-infused lives we’re currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it). As we gear up to scale to thousands of families, we’re ready to bring on an engineer to help make it happen.

**The Role**
------------


When a kid picks up a Tin Can, the call has to work the first time, every time — whether that’s a call to Grandma or a call to 911\. That promise is only as good as our ability to prove it holds before a release goes out. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Test to own that proof: the automated testing that verifies every call path works, on every change, before it reaches a kid’s phone.


You’ll own our end\-to\-end and call\-path test suites and the checks that gate a release. The surfaces are real: a staging environment where a change can place an actual SIP call before it merges; a Flutter app on iOS and Android; firmware on ESP32 devices; and a call\-decision engine whose scenario suite you’ll grow into our strongest safety net. You’ll work alongside our voice, app, infrastructure and firmware engineers, and you’ll be the person who defines what “tested” means here.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own our end\-to\-end and call\-path test suites — the automated checks that tell engineers a change is safe to ship
* Build automated SIP test calls that run in staging before every merge — real calls verified for connection, audio, voicemail, and the call record afterward
* Guarantee emergency calling with continuous, safe verification, so we can show that every Tin Can reaches 911
* Grow regression coverage across the paths families depend on most — voicemail, contact approval, missed calls — so every release protects them
* Automate the manual parts of our release process across mobile, backend, and firmware, so releases get faster and safer as the fleet grows
* Shape our CI/CD: what runs on every pull request, what gates a deploy, and what a failing check blocks
* Partner with firmware on repeatable release testing, and push on testability — device emulation, test hooks — so device behavior is verified automatically on every build
* Measure the suites themselves — coverage of the paths families use, signal engineers can trust, and defects caught before they ship

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5\+ years in software engineering, with deep experience in test automation for production systems where a failure is something a customer feels immediately
* You’ve built end\-to\-end suites engineers actually trust — fast, deterministic, wired into CI, and rare enough to be believed when they go red
* Comfortable in the guts of a distributed system; you can follow a request across services, read the telemetry, and write a test that proves behavior rather than restating the code
* Fluency using AI as a multiplier across diagnosis, analysis, and testing; this is how we work, not a nice\-to\-have
* A clear communicator who writes things down, because a test suite nobody understands is a test suite nobody maintains
* Hands\-on and scrappy; you’ll build the harness, the fixtures, and the CI plumbing yourself, and you’d rather automate a test than run it twice
* A collaborative, low\-ego approach — everyone here sweeps the floor
* Bonus: VoIP or telephony testing (SIP/RTP, sipp, synthetic call monitoring); mobile release testing across iOS and Android; or hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing for embedded devices

**Why Join Tin Can**
--------------------

* **We’re building tech that protects childhood:** We’re on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. No doomscrolling, data mining, or dopamine traps — just a simpler, better way for kids to stay in touch. This is a rare opportunity to build something that truly matters.
* **You’ll guarantee the call that matters most:** Every Tin Can can dial 911, and you’ll build the verification that proves it — then hold the same bar for every other call a family counts on, across the device, the app, and the call path.
* **Small, high\-trust team:** Every company says “team,” but at Tin Can it means something different. We’re a small, mission\-driven group that genuinely has each other’s backs — professionally and personally. You’ll be joining a tight\-knit crew where your ideas and instincts matter from day one.
* **Room to explore, not just execute:** You’ll have the space to explore new ideas, challenge assumptions, and build systems that reflect our values of trust, simplicity, and care.


If you’re excited by the idea of making every Tin Can release something families never have to think about — and building the tests and tooling that get us there — we’d love to meet you.


Compensation Range: $175K \- $195K

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, Growth
new_jobs.description:
**Software Engineer, Growth**
=============================

**About Tin Can**
-----------------


Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. We’re creating screen\-free, delightful devices and services that let families call the people who matter most, free from the noise of today’s digital world.


We’re building a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler \& better for their kids than the tech\-infused lives we’re currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it).

**The Role**
------------


Families meet Tin Can long before they hold one — on a landing page, in a friend’s text with a referral code, in an ad that made them smile. All of it is software. When it works, a family who wanted something better for their kids finds us; when a page breaks mid\-campaign or a promised referral credit never arrives, they don’t. We’re looking for a software engineer to own the systems behind how new families find Tin Can and decide to bring one home.


You’ll run our Shopify storefront, build our referral program, and own the services and APIs underneath both. You’ll build the tooling that lets growth marketers launch their own landing pages, and turn the integrations behind our storefront into systems we can test, watch, and reverse. You’ll collaborate with our growth and brand teams, and work with the engineers who own our app, voice platform, and account portal. Real money and real trust run through these systems, so you’ll go as deep as that asks.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own our Shopify storefront for acquisition — the launches and seasonal campaigns behind our biggest moments of the year
* Build our referral program end to end — invite moments, eligibility, reward fulfillment, and the identity and attribution data that makes us pay exactly once
* Own the integrations where an order becomes a customer, an activation, and a reward — the seams between platforms are where the money and the trust live
* Turn the glue behind our campaigns into services with owners, tests, alarms, and a rollback
* Build the self\-serve tooling that gets you out of the page\-building business — components, templates, version control, and monitoring, so growth marketing can publish on their own
* Build the digital half of our brand campaigns with our creative team — the sites and sign\-up flows behind the stories we want families to join
* Instrument what you ship, with the team that owns our experimentation platform, so a launch’s numbers can be trusted

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 4\+ years building and running customer\-facing web applications, with real ownership of what you shipped
* Strong TypeScript across the stack — you’ve built and run APIs in production (AWS Lambda, Cloudflare Workers, etc.)
* You’ve built integrations across third\-party platforms and think in idempotency and reconciliation, because events arrive twice, arrive late, and bring the same person back under two identities
* You prioritize testability, observability, and reliability
* You’ve built tools for non\-engineers so the people closest to a campaign don’t wait on you
* Platform judgment on commerce — what belongs inside Shopify, what belongs in a service you own, and what an integration’s credentials can reach
* Fluency using AI as a multiplier across prototyping, build, and analysis; this is how we work, not a nice\-to\-have
* You’ve worked toward campaign deadlines and know how to ship something excellent when the launch date genuinely can’t move, and you can take brand and design direction and make it look right
* A clear communicator who writes things down, and a collaborative, low\-ego approach — everyone here sweeps the floor
* **Bonus:** a referral, affiliate, or loyalty platform you integrated through its APIs, where the real work hid in identity, attribution, and reward fulfillment; Shopify theme, checkout, or app development; feature\-flag or lifecycle\-marketing tooling; an eye for craft; or growing a direct\-to\-consumer brand through real seasonal peaks

**Why Join Tin Can**
--------------------

* **We’re building tech that protects childhood:** We’re on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. No doomscrolling, data mining, or dopamine traps — just a simpler, better way for kids to stay in touch. This is a rare opportunity to build something that truly matters.
* **You’ll own the machine behind how families find us:** This is our first engineering role dedicated entirely to growth — the storefront, the referral program, and the systems underneath them are yours, including how we know they’re working.
* **Small, high\-trust team:** Every company says “team,” but at Tin Can it means something different. We’re a small, mission\-driven group that genuinely has each other’s backs — professionally and personally. You’ll be joining a tight\-knit crew where your ideas and instincts matter from day one.
* **Room to explore, not just execute:** You’ll have the space to challenge assumptions, solve hard problems, and build systems that reflect our values of trust, simplicity, and care.


If you’re excited by the idea of building the systems that bring new families to Tin Can — and making them sturdy enough to carry the biggest week of our year — we’d love to meet you.


Compensation Range: $145K \- $175K

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

  


### **ABOUT THE TEAM**


*The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large\-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers' capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.*  

  

**ABOUT THE JOB**  

  

As the Electrical Engineer, you will specify, design, develop and install devices used to collect data on solid rocket motor burn performance. Additionally, you will design custom electronic solutions—including PCBs, firmware, and FPGA code—needed to manufacture and test solid rocket motors, which will include working with integrated safety\-critical designs. This position also requires the ability to configure data collection systems and develop software applications used to collect the data. It is expected that you may oversee technicians during the instrumentation installation and during rocket motor testing/development. The right person for this role has direct, hands\-on experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors used to collect a variety of metrics related to testing of solid rocket motors. If you are a hands\-on leader, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and enjoy being the point person for collecting valuable performance data, then this role is for you. You will assist in the testing solid rocket motors which will include working with integrated safety designs used to initiate the motor.


#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Collaborates with other engineers to develop accurate, efficient equipment and instrumentation in accordance with safety and usability standards and client expectations.
* Collaborates with other electrical engineers to execute the safe arming and initiation of rocket motors under test.
* Designs PCBA and electrical system components with hands on testing and rework as necessary
* Creates detailed schematics and simulated models to test designs; optimizes designs for performance, reliability, and cost.
* Oversees the implementation of new measuring devices and control systems, ensuring devices are correctly installed and properly tested.
* Acts as project engineer for design, prototype fabrication, and manufacturing development.
* Develops required cable drawings to interface to various low\- and high\-voltage systems
* Drafts and presents formal technical documents, reports, and testing results to manager for approval.
* Provides training related to devices to employees and/or customers.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Proven experience in safety\-critical hardware design, incorporating multi\-fault tolerance, arm/fire inhibits, safe bleed\-down circuits, and inadvertent initiation mitigation.
* Experience in high\-voltage PCB layout and circuit design for motor initiation, including capacitor charging/discharge circuits, high peak\-current switching, and creepage/clearance management
* Experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors employed to collect data on system performance.
* NI Labview or NI DAQmx experience or familiar with other COTS data acquisition systems
* Thorough understanding of signal conditioning for data acquisition, i.e. analog circuit design
* Intimate knowledge of the analog to digital conversion process, i.e. digital circuit design
* Understand Computer controlled data acquisition and able to develop computer applications for data collection.
* Able to select the correct sensors and design the placement of them to acquire the needed solid rocket motor performance metrics.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and proficient with computer\-aided design software.
* Ability to write and understand Python
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance
